title: Ecuadorian banana grower, drying irrigation canal (English) — contrast partner of S1
profile_note: Sample producer: bananas, El Oro, Ecuador. Same challenge tags as S1 (climate and weather, water) but a different crop and region; used to check the agent keeps distinct producers distinct.

turns.message: The irrigation canal that feeds our banana plots has been drying up, and the bunches are failing before they ripen.
It has been getting worse for two years. We pump water from a river now, but the level keeps dropping and the fuel costs are high.

intake_replies: We also try to time planting with the rains, but the rains have become unpredictable.
